name: PngAlphaBenchmarkToolkit
summary: Lossless ISO/IEC 15948 PNG Alpha-Channel Analysis & Scanline Filter Optimization Suite
description: Open-source engineering benchmark suite evaluating lossless PNG (ISO/IEC 15948) scanline filter heuristics (Sub, Up, Average, Paeth) and zero-alpha RGB entropy elimination across cutout raster datasets (ORCID 0009-0006-7606-8791, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23878416).
